title: Spielberg: UFOs as future humans
summary: Steven Spielberg tells of Spielberg: UFOs as future humans, about 2020s at undated, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: What if they're not from an advanced civilization 300 million lighty years from here? But what if it's us 500,000 years into the future?

plain: Steven Spielberg, the film director, once wondered aloud to the TV host Stephen Colbert whether UFOs might not come from a distant advanced civilisation at all. In the clip, played on a podcast episode with a musician, Spielberg asks: what if "it's us 500,000 years into the future?" The idea is that the visitors would be our own descendants coming back in time.
